(Search snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; Bloomberg's own reporting language)
The Bank of England is expected to deliver its first rate hike in over three years on Thursday, according to a Bloomberg survey of 35 economists conducted at the end of last week. All respondents — who were polled between Oct. 29 and Oct. 30 — expect the rate to be raised to 4% from 3.75%, the level at which it was kept for 11 months.
